_: What each terminal shows: an entry per terminal id (the prop's label, or a terminal:<id> tag on it), else 'default'. 'banner' is the lines printed on login; 'files' maps a file name to its text (newlines as \n).

banner: unlicensed use is a contract matter
type HELP for commands, LS for files

files.readme.txt:
Crew terminals are for shift logs, requisitions and messages.
Do not store personal material on company nodes.
Do not attempt to reach the operations network from a crew node.
files.shift_log.txt:
SHIFT 0412  drill 3 down again, seal on the feed line. Reported.
SHIFT 0413  seal replaced. Drill 3 up. Tally short by 2 crates.
SHIFT 0414  tally still short. Nobody has seen crates 17 and 18.
SHIFT 0415  told to stop logging the tally.
files.notice.txt:
NOTICE TO ALL CREW
The cabins on the crew hall are numbered 1 to 8. Cabin S1 is room four.
Lights in the hall are on the switch at either end.
Report every leak. Check your seals before the airlock, not after.

banner: logged in as the cabin's occupant
type HELP for commands, LS for files

files.readme.txt:
This node is yours for the length of your contract.
Messages from the desk arrive here. Read them.
files.message_01.txt:
FROM: DESK
Welcome aboard. Your kit is in the footlocker. The stool is bolted down; the company has learned.
Shift assignments follow.
